plan.notes: Source: official Queensborough Community College degree map PDF 'A.S. in Computer Science - MA-440 Placement - Catalog Year 2025-26' (last updated 2/21/25), URL in source_url. Transcribed 2026-09-30 via browser_open text fetch of the official PDF; no courses invented. This is the MA-440 math-placement variant (4 semesters: Fall #1 / Spring #1 / Fall #2 / Spring #2); Queensborough also publishes MA-119 and MA-441 placement variants (5-semester/developmental paths) which were NOT used here. Official term totals: 16 + 14 + 15 + 15 = 60, matching the catalog's 'Total credits required for the degree: 60'. Credit-range handling: Fall #1 prints two distinct 'One course from Flexible Core 2A, 2B, 2C, or 2D' 3-credit rows (term total 16 requires both; note 2 of the PDF requires one course from each of 2A, 2B, 2C, and 2D across the degree: 2+1+0+1 = 4). Spring #2 prints the 1C science slot as 3-4 credits and the lab as 0-1 credits with term total 15; the plan records the 4-credit science + 0-credit lab combination (a STEM-variant/4-credit 1C science with integrated lab satisfies the lab requirement per PDF note 4), so individual students may total 14-16 in this term depending on choices. Catalog quirks documented, not 'fixed': (a) the PDF lists MA-440's own prerequisite as 'MA-440 (C or better)' - a self-referential typo; recorded with prereq [] here and PDF note 1 (MA-119/MA-121 may be required by placement prior to MA-440) summarized in this note; (b) the developmental HTML map at qcc.cuny.edu/academics/degree-programs/maps/qcc/as-computer-science.html labels MA-443 as 'Calculus II' while the Pathways list and this PDF confirm MA-441=Calc I / MA-442=Calc II / MA-443=Calc III; this PDF variant is used, so no mislabeled course appears. Corequisites from the official map (not encoded as prereqs): CS-101 corequisite MA-441 (same term); science laboratory corequisite the 3-credit 1C science course. Placement details ('complete developmental requirements in English/math or placement') kept out of external_prereqs and recorded here. Degree requirements beyond courses: all students must complete two (2) WI-designated classes; CS-101 satisfies Flexible Core 2E; MA-442 satisfies the additional Flexible Core requirement. True program name per QCC Factbook is CSCI-AS Computer Science, marketed as 'A.S. in Computer Science'. No invented data: every course code/title/credit is verbatim from the official map.
